hook_patterns.pattern: Open on extreme close-up of [subject detail], pull back to reveal full scene
hook_patterns.example: Open on extreme close-up of water droplets on leather jacket, pull back to reveal a figure standing in rain-soaked alley

hook_patterns.pattern: Subject walks into frame from off-screen, stops dead, looks directly into camera
hook_patterns.example: Subject strides in from left edge, stops sharp, locks eyes with the camera — dead silence for half a beat

hook_patterns.pattern: Cut to black for 0.5s, then smash-cut to the most visually striking frame of the video
hook_patterns.example: 0.5s black leader, then smash-cut to subject mid-action with full motion blur and peak color

hook_patterns.pattern: Slow push-in on a still subject, then subject suddenly moves
hook_patterns.example: Slow push-in on model standing perfectly still in golden light, then she turns sharply on the beat

hook_patterns.pattern: Text on black: [counterintuitive claim]. Then cut to visual proof.
hook_patterns.example: Text on black: 'You've been doing this wrong.' Then cut to the correct method shown visually.

hook_patterns.pattern: Aerial drone descends rapidly from sky into a scene
hook_patterns.example: Drone falls from clouds, descends into golden coastline, reveals subject standing at shoreline

hook_patterns.pattern: Start in the middle of a conversation — no setup, mid-sentence energy
hook_patterns.example: Audio starts mid-sentence: '...and that's exactly why nobody tells you this.' — subject already in frame looking at camera

hook_patterns.pattern: Product / subject appears from behind a surface with a reveal wipe
hook_patterns.example: Bottle slides from behind white surface into frame, catching light as it rotates

hook_patterns.pattern: Match cut between two visually rhyming shots from different worlds
hook_patterns.example: Cup of coffee spinning — match cut to earth spinning from space — then back to the cup lifting to lips

hook_patterns.pattern: Whip pan to subject surrounded by chaos, they remain perfectly still
hook_patterns.example: Whip pan chaos of a busy street, then landing on subject completely composed — calm amid the storm

narrative_arcs.name: reveal_arc
narrative_arcs.beat_1: Establish the familiar — show the problem or ordinary state visually
narrative_arcs.beat_2: Interrupt — something unexpected enters the frame or the narrative flips
narrative_arcs.beat_3: Reveal — show the new truth, product, or transformation

narrative_arcs.name: aspiration_arc
narrative_arcs.beat_1: Show the aspirational outcome first — the life, the result, the feeling
narrative_arcs.beat_2: Pull back the curtain — how or why this is achievable
narrative_arcs.beat_3: Direct invitation — here's how you get there, CTA

narrative_arcs.name: tension_release_arc
narrative_arcs.beat_1: Open in conflict — stress, problem, high-energy chaos
narrative_arcs.beat_2: Escalate the tension — make it feel urgent
narrative_arcs.beat_3: Release — resolution arrives, brand is the relief

narrative_arcs.name: social_proof_arc
narrative_arcs.beat_1: Open with a bold claim that creates curiosity or skepticism
narrative_arcs.beat_2: Show evidence — real results, reactions, or proof
narrative_arcs.beat_3: Reframe — the claim was right, here's why it matters to you

narrative_arcs.name: visual_journey_arc
narrative_arcs.beat_1: Pure visual immersion — no text, just the world of the brand
narrative_arcs.beat_2: Movement builds — increasing pace, music lifts
narrative_arcs.beat_3: Peak visual moment — the money shot lands as music hits
